earnings.title: East West Bancorp, Inc.
highlights: EAST WEST BANCORP REPORTS RECORD QUARTERLY NET INCOME OF $382 MILLION AND RECORD QUARTERLY DILUTED EARNINGS PER SHARE OF $2.76 ON RECORD TOTAL REVENUE
(“East West” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: EWBC), parent company of East West Bank, reported third quarter 2026 net income of $382 million, or $2.76 per diluted share.

quotes.text: I am pleased to report another record-breaking quarter for East West.
quotes.by: Dominic Ng, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer
